description:
Found while building fz-sc8.72. World::resolve_module_name (src/compiler2/world.rs) returns Option<ModuleId> but every branch returns Some: an unbound name falls back to reference_module. Six callers carry an error path that can never run: resolve_struct_module and record_struct_reference (jobs/body.rs), SourcePatternResolver::struct_type and SourcePatternResolver::module_alias_atom (compiler2/dispatch.rs), the source_publish expects, and lower_alias (jobs/body.rs) with World::module_alias_atom.

Make it return ModuleId and delete the six dead paths and their diagnostics. A pure fold: no behaviour changes, so no fixture moves; the deleted diagnostics' codes are checked for other users first. Lands ahead of fz-sc8.25, which reworks qualified-call resolution on top of this function.
title: resolve_module_name is total, and its dead error paths go
